name: Arab-Norman Palermo and the Cathedral Churches of Cefalú and Monreale
description: On Sicily's northern coast, nine twelfth-century buildings in and around Palermo, along with the cathedrals of Cefalù and Monreale, show what happened when Norman kings ruled an island of Muslims, Byzantine Greeks and Latin Christians. Palaces, churches and a bridge blend Islamic, Byzantine and Western styles into a look found nowhere else, and they are still being restored today.
